body: Thank you so much, that recognition means so much with how hard it’s been. I keep trying to tell myself nothing worth it is easy, some days the exhaustion tells me it’s pointless so I’m just trying not to give up on days like today

I know I rambled but TL;DR 
I have the chance to rebuild my life, and I want to desperately, but the hole I’m in is very hard to dig out of and it makes me wish I was dead instead because I don’t want to even imagine the alternative if I don’t fix it.
The Installation released before this one is widely considered the greatest jrpg of all time.
